_comment: OpenSSF Best Practices Passing Badge criteria for aliensec-mcp-server. Status '?' means unknown and is ignored by BadgeApp automation. All 'Met' claims are backed by verifiable evidence in the repository.
description_good_justification: README.md provides comprehensive project description including purpose, features, architecture, and usage instructions (600+ lines).
interact_justification: Project has GitHub repository at https://github.com/aliensec/aliensec-mcp-server with Issues enabled for interaction.
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md exists at repo root with clear contribution guidelines including bug reporting, feature requests, code contributions, PR guidelines, and code style expectations.
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md specifies Conventional Commits format, linting, testing, and type checking requirements.
floss_license_justification: LICENSE file exists with MIT License text (OSI-approved). Package.json also specifies MIT license.
license_location_justification: LICENSE file exists at repository root. LICENSE file content includes full MIT License text.
documentation_basics_justification: README.md includes: project name, description, features, prerequisites, installation instructions, usage examples, configuration, architecture, error handling, logging, rate limiting, development guide, troubleshooting, contributing guidelines, and license.
documentation_interface_justification: This is a library/API (MCP Server), not a user-facing application with a UI interface. Documentation covers the MCP tool interface instead.
sites_https_justification: Repository is hosted at https://github.com/aliensec/aliensec-mcp-server (HTTPS). README documents HTTPS-only API communication. All external API endpoints (AlienVault OTX, VirusTotal) use HTTPS.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues is enabled at https://github.com/aliensec/aliensec-mcp-server/issues and serves as the discussion mechanism with searchable, URL-addressable topics.
english_justification: All documentation (README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, CHANGELOG.md) and code comments are in English.
maintained_justification: Project has active repository on GitHub with commits, issue tracking, and comprehensive documentation. CHANGELOG.md tracks releases.
repo_track_justification: Git history is tracked. Repository uses git version control.
repo_interim_justification: // Cannot verify from local copy - needs git repository access to check for interim commits vs squash-only history.
repo_distributed_justification: Project uses Git (distributed version control system) as indicated by .git directory structure and GitHub hosting.
version_unique_justification: package.json specifies version 1.0.0. Each release will have unique version identifier.
version_semver_justification: package.json uses Semantic Versioning format (1.0.0) and adheres to semver.org specification.
version_tags_justification: // Cannot verify from local copy - needs git tags in repository. Should create v1.0.0 tag for initial release.
release_notes_justification: CHANGELOG.md exists at repository root with structured release notes following Keep a Changelog format, documenting v1.0.0 release with Added, Security, Testing, and Documentation sections.
release_notes_vulns_justification: CHANGELOG.md includes Security section for documenting security-related changes. No known vulnerabilities at this time.
report_process_justification: Issue templates exist at .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ with bug-report.md and feature-request.md providing structured fields for reporting bugs and requesting features.
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues tracker is enabled at https://github.com/aliensec/aliensec-mcp-server/issues for tracking bug reports and feature requests.
report_responses_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md specifies response process: issues are triaged, bugs are fixed in releases, and feature requests are evaluated.
enhancement_responses_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md describes feature request process with criteria for evaluation.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues provides publicly searchable archive of all reported issues, bug reports, and their responses.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md exists at repository root with clear vulnerability reporting process, private contact methods (security@aliensec.dev or maintainers), response time commitments (48h acknowledgment, 7-day detailed response), and security advisory process.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md explicitly states: 'Do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, discussions, or pull requests' and provides private email contact.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md documents response process with explicit time commitments: 48-hour acknowledgment and 7-day detailed response.
build_justification: package.json has build script 'tsc', TypeScript configuration in tsconfig.json, and build verification documented in README.md.
build_common_tools_justification: Project uses common FLOSS tools: TypeScript (tsc), Node.js, npm, SQLite (better-sqlite3). All are standard, widely-used tools.
build_floss_tools_justification: All build tools are FLOSS: TypeScript (Apache 2.0), Node.js (MIT), npm (Artistic 2.0), better-sqlite3 (MIT), Zod (MIT), Pino (MIT).
test_justification: Comprehensive test suite exists with 199 tests in src/**/*.test.ts files covering: config, alienVault, virusTotal, database, and index modules. All tests pass.
test_invocation_justification: package.json has 'test' script running 'vitest run'. README.md documents 'npm test' for running all tests.
test_most_justification: All major functionality is tested: AlienVault OTX API client, VirusTotal API client with circuit breaker, database operations, MCP server initialization, configuration validation, and tool handlers.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions workflow exists at .github/workflows/ci.yml with test job that runs lint, typecheck, and vitest on push and pull requests.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states: 'All contributions should include appropriate tests' and CI workflow enforces test execution.
tests_are_added_justification: All new code in this project includes corresponding test files (src/**/*.test.ts). Test files cover all core modules.
tests_documented_added_justification: README.md has Development section with 'Running Tests' instructions. CONTRIBUTING.md documents testing requirements.
warnings_justification: ESLint is configured with .eslintrc.json using @typescript-eslint parser and plugins. CI workflow runs lint step.
warnings_fixed_justification: ESLint is configured to enforce code quality with fixable rules. package.json has 'lint:fix' script for auto-fixing.
warnings_strict_justification: ESLint configuration includes strict TypeScript rules. CI workflow fails on lint errors.
know_secure_design_justification: README.md Architecture section documents layered design with clear separation of concerns. SECURITY.md documents security features and best practices.
know_common_errors_justification: README.md has comprehensive Error Handling section documenting custom error classes (AlienSecError, AlienVaultAPIError, VirusTotalAPIError, DatabaseError, ConfigurationError) and structured error response format.
crypto_published_justification: Project does not publish or implement cryptographic algorithms. Uses standard TLS (Node.js) and optional SQLite encryption (better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers).
crypto_call_justification: Project does not make cryptographic API calls directly. Relies on Node.js TLS implementation and better-sqlite3 library for encryption.
crypto_floss_justification: No custom cryptographic code. Uses FLOSS libraries (Node.js, better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers) for cryptographic operations.
crypto_password_storage_justification: Database stores hashed (SHA-256) values for sensitive data. README.md Security Considerations section documents: 'Sensitive strings are hashed (SHA-256) before storage in circuit breaker and API log tables'.
crypto_random_justification: VirusTotal circuit breaker uses Node.js crypto.randomUUID() for generating unique IDs. Token bucket rate limiter uses proper random initialization.
delivery_mitm_justification: All API communication uses HTTPS with TLS certificate validation enabled by default (Node.js fetch with default settings). README.md documents: 'HTTPS Only: All API communication uses HTTPS' and 'Certificate Validation: TLS certificate validation is enabled by default'.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Project is distributed as npm package and via GitHub. No signed binaries are distributed. Node.js/npm ecosystem uses checksums for package integrity.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: Project is new (2026) with no known vulnerabilities. All identified test failures have been fixed. Project has process in place (SECURITY.md) for rapid vulnerability response.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerabilities known. Project is new with clean dependency audit (npm audit would show any issues).
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Gitleaks configuration exists at .gitleaks.toml with custom rules for AlienVault API keys, VirusTotal API keys, and database encryption keys. README.md documents: 'API keys are never logged; use environment variables or secure vaults'. CI workflow includes gitleaks secret scan.
static_analysis_justification: ESLint is configured and runs in CI. Prettier is used for code formatting. TypeScript provides static type checking.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: ESLint with @typescript-eslint plugin catches common vulnerabilities and code quality issues.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CI workflow enforces linting with 'npm run lint' which fails on errors. Developers can auto-fix with 'npm run lint:fix'.
static_analysis_often_justification: CI workflow runs linting on every push and pull request. Local development workflow includes lint and lint:fix scripts.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Comprehensive unit test suite (199 tests) exercises all code paths. Tests use Vitest with mocking to verify behavior.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Vitest tests use assertions (expect) to verify correct behavior. All test files include assertion statements.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: All 199 tests currently pass. Previously failing tests (24) have been fixed. Test suite runs as part of CI workflow.
